prose: Mark Steeves is the intrepid host of a podcast called My Family Thinks I'm Crazy. This guy is a budding guru in the "conspirtuality" scene, and in a very short amount of time he's built an amazing internet presence for truth, love, and good vibes with his work. We catch up with some talk about the holiday / holly-daze, discuss reincarnation and eternal life, and signs & symbols of the M-Pyre.
ext: We go deep into Tartaria talk, ancient earthworks, mudflood, the "underworld," the Wizard of Oz, and Mark's thoughts on staying in the flow state woo-way.
music: "Lionhearted (Emancipator flip ft. Devin Mikel)" by Zen Tempest
